{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Drop duplicates based on patient_id, keeping the first occurrence
trial_df_clean = trial_df.drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Check the distribution of 'severity' across sites to assess comparability
severity_by_site = trial_df_clean.groupby('site')['severity'].value_counts(normalize=True)
print("Severity distribution by site:\n", severity_by_site)"}
